subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the measured no-go satisfy this issue’s explicit stop condition, or should ClawHub sponsor a materially different bounded route-entry experiment?
rationale: The requested first A/B was completed and failed its reduction gate, but current main still has the underlying coupling; deciding whether investigation completion is sufficient is a product and prioritization choice, not a narrow code repair.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the documented failed extraction as completing this bounded investigation and retain broader performance work in the umbrella issue.

options.title: Sponsor another experiment
options.body: Keep this issue active only after naming a different cross-route import hypothesis and preserving the existing measurement and waterfall stop gates.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the documented failed extraction as completing this bounded investigation and retain broader performance work in the umbrella issue.
